title: T‑Mobile Brings More to the Holiday Mix: Deals on the Season’s Must-Have Tech, All-New T-Mix Plans and More
summary: Unwrap big savings on iPhone and the latest Apple devices, Home Internet and more, with holiday offers across T‑Mobile, Metro by T‑Mobile, Mint Mobile and T‑Mobile for Business — all on America’s Best Network
body_markdown:
**BELLEVUE, Wash.** **— Nov. 3, 2026** — The season of giving is getting a serious upgrade. Starting Thursday, Nov. 5, T‑Mobile (NASDAQ: TMUS) is rolling out deals on the season’s hottest tech, with savings across T‑Mobile, Metro by T‑Mobile, Mint Mobile and T‑Mobile for Business. T‑Mobile customers can score[iPhone 18 Pro](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone/apple-iphone-18-pro?icid=MGPO_TMO_U_26PPI18PBY_7877G506074O7Q9767994) and[iPhone 17](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone/apple-iphone-17) , both[on Us](https://www.t-mobile.com/offers?msockid=153bcf369fdc6bcb1e1cdacd9e666acf) , plus up to $1,200 off[iPhone Duo](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone/apple-iphone-duo?msockid=153bcf369fdc6bcb1e1cdacd9e666acf) . Looking to get connected at home? Save up to $200 on[5G Home Internet](https://www.t-mobile.com/home-internet) . At Metro by T‑Mobile, grab[iPhone 16e](https://www.metrobyt-mobile.com/cell-phone/apple-iphone-16e)[on Us](https://www.metrobyt-mobile.com/deals?msockid=153bcf369fdc6bcb1e1cdacd9e666acf) . Mint Mobile is also spreading the holiday cheer by offering[plans at $15/month](https://www.mintmobile.com/) . And businesses can get in on the savings with[iPhone 18 Pro Max](https://www.t-mobile.com/business/cell-phone/apple-iphone-18-pro-max?msockid=153bcf369fdc6bcb1e1cdacd9e666acf)[on Us](https://www.t-mobile.com/business/offers/business-deals-hub?msockid=153bcf369fdc6bcb1e1cdacd9e666acf) . Whatever’s on the wish list, there’s something for everyone this holiday season — all on[America’s Best Network](https://www.t-mobile.com/coverage/network?cmpid=MGPO_PB_P_25REDSHELL_296018427550_132900462902_&gclid=c335ebef3c17123d70e2813615c786f3&gclsrc=3p.ds&msclkid=c335ebef3c17123d70e2813615c786f3) .


## More Choice, More Picks, Your Mix


This holiday season, T‑Mobile is giving customers more than just great deals on the latest devices. With all-new[T-Mix plans](https://www.t-mobile.com/news/un-carrier/t-mobile-introduces-tmix) launching in November, customers get more choice in the benefits included in their wireless plan, with the flexibility to change them as their needs evolve. T-Mix plans — Standard, More and Loaded — come with Picks, which customers can use to choose the benefits they want from a lineup of options across device promotions, streaming, music, travel, AI assistants, on-demand delivery, gaming and more. Whether it’s capturing holiday memories with the incredible camera system on iPhone 18 Pro, streaming holiday favorites on Apple TV, jamming to festive playlists on Apple Music, staying connected with loved ones over video with Optimized Video Calls or earning miles toward their next getaway with Delta, customers can make the season their own. And when their needs change, they can switch up their mix throughout the year without changing their plan. Plus, all the T‑Mobile perks customers know and love still come standard, including weekly deals and freebies with[T‑Mobile Tuesdays](https://www.t-mobile.com/offers/t-mobile-tuesdays?msockid=153bcf369fdc6bcb1e1cdacd9e666acf) ,[exclusive travel benefits](https://www.t-mobile.com/benefits/travel?msockid=153bcf369fdc6bcb1e1cdacd9e666acf) ,[premium experiences at events nationwide](https://www.t-mobiletickets.com/) and[more](https://www.t-mobile.com/benefits?msockid=153bcf369fdc6bcb1e1cdacd9e666acf) . T-Mix brings more choice and more flexibility, all on[America’s Best Network](https://www.t-mobile.com/coverage/network?INTNAV=tNav%3ACoverage%3ANetwork) .


Looking to make the holidays a little merrier? Here’s a look at the deals T‑Mobile is unwrapping for new and existing customers, unless otherwise noted:


- [iPhone 18 Pro](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone/apple-iphone-18-pro?icid=MGPO_TMO_U_26PPI18PBY_7877G506074O7Q9767994)[on Us](https://www.t-mobile.com/offers?msockid=153bcf369fdc6bcb1e1cdacd9e666acf) (or up to $1,200 off any iPhone 18 Pro model or[iPhone Duo](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone/apple-iphone-duo?msockid=153bcf369fdc6bcb1e1cdacd9e666acf) ) when trading in an eligible device — in any condition! — on[Experience Beyond](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone-plans?INTNAV=tNav%3APlans) OR when bringing a number to T‑Mobile and activating a new line (with no trade-in required) on[Experience Beyond](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone-plans?INTNAV=tNav%3APlans) or a qualifying[T-Mix](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone-plans?INTNAV=tNav%3APlans) plan with 3 Picks.
- [iPhone 17](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone/apple-iphone-17)[on Us](https://www.t-mobile.com/offers?msockid=153bcf369fdc6bcb1e1cdacd9e666acf) (or up to $930 off any iPhone 18 Pro model, iPhone 17 model, or[iPhone Duo](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone/apple-iphone-duo?msockid=153bcf369fdc6bcb1e1cdacd9e666acf) ) when trading in an eligible device on[Experience More](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone-plans?INTNAV=tNav%3APlans) /[Experience Beyond](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone-plans?INTNAV=tNav%3APlans) OR when bringing a number to T‑Mobile and activating a new line (with no trade-in required) on[Experience More](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone-plans?INTNAV=tNav%3APlans) /[Experience Beyond](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone-plans?INTNAV=tNav%3APlans) or a qualifying[T-Mix](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone-plans?INTNAV=tNav%3APlans) plan with 2 Picks.
- [Apple Watch SE 3](https://www.t-mobile.com/smart-watch/apple-watch-se-3-40mm?msockid=153bcf369fdc6bcb1e1cdacd9e666acf)[on Us](https://www.t-mobile.com/offers?msockid=153bcf369fdc6bcb1e1cdacd9e666acf) (up to $300) when adding a watch line on a qualifying plan OR get $250 off any[Apple Watch](https://www.t-mobile.com/smart-watches/brand/apple?msockid=153bcf369fdc6bcb1e1cdacd9e666acf) when picking up another Apple Watch.
- [iPad (A16)](https://www.t-mobile.com/tablet/apple-ipad-a16?msockid=153bcf369fdc6bcb1e1cdacd9e666acf) for just $199 when adding a tablet line on a qualifying plan.
- Need phones for the whole fam? Customers who switch to T‑Mobile and sign up for[T-Mix Standard](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone-plans?INTNAV=tNav%3APlans) can get four lines for just $25 per line/month (with AutoPay; plus taxes and fees) and four[iPhone 17e](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone/apple-iphone-17e?cmpid=MGPO_PB_P_EVGRIPHN_2465371801142_194367807758_&gclid=4c9a6c5bd4f414baf24e0681578ef9b9&gclsrc=3p.ds&msclkid=4c9a6c5bd4f414baf24e0681578ef9b9)[on Us](https://www.t-mobile.com/offers?msockid=153bcf369fdc6bcb1e1cdacd9e666acf) with 4 Picks — no trade-in required!
- And there’s more! Check out additional offers[here](https://www.t-mobile.com/offers?INTNAV=tNav%3ADeals) starting Nov. 5.


All the device offers above, including the four iPhone 17e, are available with up to 36 monthly bill credits, plus tax.


## T‑Mobile Home Internet


The holidays bring more streaming, guests and devices online at once. T‑Mobile helps households stay connected with fast, reliable internet:


- [5G Home Internet](https://www.t-mobile.com/home-internet) starting at $30/month with a voice line and AutoPay, plus taxes and fees — save $20/month, plus get one month free and up to $200 back. With free[same-day delivery](https://www.t-mobile.com/home-internet/doordash-same-day-internet) powered by DoorDash, households can get connected in time for holiday hosting.
- [T‑Mobile Fiber](https://www.t-mobile.com/home-internet/fiber) starting at $35/month with AutoPay, plus taxes and fees. Need more speed for the holiday rush? The new 5 Gig plan is available for $90/month with AutoPay, plus taxes and fees, and comes with a 10-year price guarantee. For a limited time, get Fiber 5 Gig with two months free and $300 back.


## T‑Mobile for Business


The holiday hustle is real for businesses, and T‑Mobile is bringing big savings on the latest devices to help keep teams connected and businesses moving starting Nov. 5: ****

- [iPhone 18 Pro](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone/apple-iphone-18-pro)[on Us](https://www.t-mobile.com/business/offers/business-deals-hub?msockid=153bcf369fdc6bcb1e1cdacd9e666acf) (or up to $1,200 off any iPhone 18 Pro model or[iPhone Duo](https://www.t-mobile.com/cell-phone/apple-iphone-duo?msockid=153bcf369fdc6bcb1e1cdacd9e666acf) ) when upgrading and trading in an eligible device — in any condition! — on[SuperMobile](https://www.t-mobile.com/business/wireless-business-plans?INTNAV=tNav%3APlans%3AUnlimitedPhonePlan) .
- [iPad (A16)](https://www.t-mobile.com/tablet/apple-ipad-a16?msockid=153bcf369fdc6bcb1e1cdacd9e666acf) for $299 when adding a tablet line on a qualifying plan.


All the device offers above are available with up to 24 monthly bill credits, plus tax.


## Metro by T‑Mobile


This holiday season, Metro is bringing big savings with affordable plans backed by a price guarantee on talk, text and 5G data — with no contracts or credit checks for select plans, all on America’s Best Network. Customers can score these holiday deals, available now online or in-store:


- [iPhone 16e](https://www.metrobyt-mobile.com/cell-phone/apple-iphone-16e)[on Us](https://www.metrobyt-mobile.com/deals?msockid=153bcf369fdc6bcb1e1cdacd9e666acf) (after rebate via virtual prepaid Mastercard following the third monthly payment) when bringing a number to Metro and signing up for a qualifying plan.
- [$15 BYOD](https://www.metrobyt-mobile.com/deals/one-line-for-25-phone-plan?cmpid=MTPR_PB_P_25MTR5PGBY_841297024722_152643359511_&gclid=249e55f8012c1cdc9f253cf93eb9ca62&gclsrc=3p.ds&msclkid=249e55f8012c1cdc9f253cf93eb9ca62&utm_source=bing&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=Metro_Prospect_Brand_Core_B_English&utm_term=metro%20by%20t%20mo&utm_content=Metro_Brand_Core_MbTM) (Keep Your Phone) — Already have a phone? For a limited time only, customers can bring their number and get unlimited 5G data for just $15/month for the first three months, with no activation fee. No port required if purchased online.
- And there’s even more to unwrap! Find additional holiday deals[here](https://www.metrobyt-mobile.com/deals?INTNAV=tNav%3ADeals) .


## Mint Mobile


The holiday deals continue at Mint, with affordable wireless and extra savings to make the season a little brighter — all on America’s largest 5G network. Check out the holiday offers available now:


- [$15/month for all Mint plans, even Unlimited](https://www.mintmobile.com/) — switch and save on 3, 6 or 12-month plans.
- Plus, even more great deals[here](https://www.mintmobile.com/deals/) .


Follow the T‑Mobile Newsroom on[X](https://x.com/tmobilenews) and[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/tmobilenews/) to catch the latest company updates.

**About T‑Mobile US, Inc.**


As the supercharged Un-carrier, T‑Mobile US, Inc. (NASDAQ: TMUS) is powered by an award-winning 5G network that connects more people, in more places, than ever before. With T‑Mobile’s unique value proposition of best network, best value and best experiences, the Un-carrier is redefining connectivity and fueling competition while continuing to drive the next wave of innovation in wireless and beyond. Headquartered in Bellevue, Wash., T‑Mobile provides services through its subsidiaries and operates its flagship brands, T‑Mobile, Metro by T‑Mobile and Mint Mobile.
